answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. What survives to the kernel is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. Each submission hangs on the comet of a task receipt, and the reef is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
